annotation.title_clean: Study to support an impact assessment of regulatory requirements for Artificial Intelligence in Europe
annotation.title_en: Study to support an impact assessment of regulatory requirements for Artificial Intelligence in Europe
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (DG CONNECT)
annotation.venue: Publications Office of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Publications Office catalogue page for the final report of a study for DG CONNECT supporting the impact assessment of the proposed EU AI Regulation. It covers AI risks to fundamental rights and safety, national AI strategies, analysis of the White Paper consultation, and compliance cost estimates.
key_provisions_or_claims: Section 1 reviews evidence on AI risks and harms to fundamental rights and safety/security
Section 2 compares national AI strategies and regulatory frameworks, focusing on risk governance
Section 3 analyses 6,667 free-text responses and 408 position papers from the White Paper consultation
Section 4 estimates administrative and substantive compliance costs of the proposed AI Regulation
